answer.content: The research question must isolate memory retention probability using only the per-interval retention metric from Section 4.1 of Kumar et al., 2024, under bounded token budgets and known perturbations. Acceptance criteria: the question must be specific, measurable, and directly tied to a single, verifiable metric from the cited paper, with no extension to broader coherence or drift metrics; all conditions must reflect intermittent input and interval-level retention variation over 100 update intervals. No external assumptions or unverified generalizations are permitted. The formulation must exclude any reference to non-metric performance indicators such as task completion or user satisfaction. This ensures empirical rigor and prevents ungrounded comparisons with other memory models or systems. The resulting question will serve as a foundation for comparative analysis in subsequent phases.
